data.comment:
# Comfy Wan Dancer- Music to Dance

Generate minute-scale coherent dance videos from music using a hierarchical Wan Dancer framework. Input a music file and reference image to produce high-resolution dance videos with global structure and temporal continuity. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs a COMFY_API_KEY.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/video_wan_dancer.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.
